WITH source_counts AS (
  SELECT p.fundflux, COUNT(*) AS survey_count
  FROM scanspatial AS s
  JOIN projects AS p ON p.arcregistry = s.arcref
  GROUP BY p.fundflux
),
totals AS (
  SELECT SUM(survey_count) AS total_surveys,
         AVG(survey_count * 1.0) AS average_count
  FROM source_counts
)
SELECT sc.fundflux AS source,
       sc.survey_count AS count,
       sc.survey_count * 1.0 / totals.total_surveys AS share,
       sc.survey_count - totals.average_count AS above_average
FROM source_counts AS sc
CROSS JOIN totals
WHERE sc.survey_count > totals.average_count
